steps.player: I'll have a pint of beer please.

steps.npc: Ok, that'll be two coins please.

steps.text: If the player does not have two coins:

steps.player: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.

options.text: Any hints where I can go adventuring?

steps.player: Any hints on where I can go adventuring?

steps.npc: Well there is the Varrock sewers. There are tales of untold horrors coming out at night and stealing babies from houses.
It's just to the east of the palace.
I'm not that well up on the gossip out here. I've heard that the bartender in the Blue Moon Inn has gone a little crazy, he keeps claiming he is part of something called an online game.
What that means, I don't know. That's probably old news by now though.
